query: how long are backups retained
doc:
Operations handbook.

On-call rotates weekly on Mondays at 09:00 and the outgoing engineer writes a short handover note in the ops channel.

Incidents are declared in the incident tool; severity one pages the whole platform group and requires a status page update within fifteen minutes.

Database snapshots run nightly at 02:00 UTC. They are kept for 35 days in a separate cloud account and restored into staging every Friday to prove they work.

Secrets rotate every ninety days through the vault; never paste them into chat or tickets.

Capacity reviews happen at the start of each quarter with finance in the room.

query: what is the refund window for annual plans
doc:
Billing policy.

Monthly subscriptions renew on the same calendar day and can be cancelled at any time; cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period.

Annual plans are billed upfront with a two month discount. Customers may ask for their money back within 30 days of purchase, after which the plan runs to the end of its term.

Invoices are issued in euros for European customers and in dollars elsewhere, and VAT is added where it applies.

Enterprise contracts follow their own signed terms and are handled by the account team rather than support.
